sources.title: NIST additive manufacturing test artifact
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 定向能量沉積修復
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三長度／三方向補償圖與保留試片驗證。；教學最終尺寸 40.00±0.05 mm，須以保留試片確認；只校準一次不能宣稱批次通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver three-length/three-direction compensation and held-out-coupon validation.; Teaching final size 40.00±0.05 mm needs a held-out coupon; one calibration does not qualify a batch.
related.difference: 建立掃描缺損、補料體積與精加工餘量的一致基準，分清成形外觀與冶金結合證據。
related.differenceEn: Reconcile scan loss, deposited volume and machining allowance without confusing shape recovery with metallurgical bonding.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Lfinal=Lcad(1−s)，因此 Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s)。；教學目標 Ltarget=40.00 mm，線性收縮率 s=0.005。；Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm。
近似矩形槽以 V=Lwh 計體積；捕獲率只連接送粉質量與沉積質量，不代表熔合品質。 教學槽長 40 mm、寬 6 mm、缺損深 1.2 mm，另留 0.3 mm 加工量；密度 8.0 g/cm³，捕獲率 0.60。 V=40×6×1.5=360 mm³=0.360 cm³；沉積質量 2.88 g，估計供粉 2.88/0.60=4.80 g。忽略側壁坡度與稀釋。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Lfinal=Lcad(1−s), hence Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s).; Teaching target Ltarget=40.00 mm and linear shrinkage s=0.005.; Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm.

For a rectangular groove V=Lwh; capture efficiency connects supplied and deposited mass, not bond quality. Teaching groove: 40×6 mm, loss depth 1.2 mm, allowance 0.3 mm; density 8.0 g/cm³ and capture fraction 0.60. V=40×6×1.5=360 mm³=0.360 cm³; deposit mass 2.88 g and feed estimate 2.88/0.60=4.80 g. Side slopes and dilution are omitted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 閉模鍛造成形
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付三長度／三方向補償圖與保留試片驗證。；教學最終尺寸 40.00±0.05 mm，須以保留試片確認；只校準一次不能宣稱批次通過。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver three-length/three-direction compensation and held-out-coupon validation.; Teaching final size 40.00±0.05 mm needs a held-out coupon; one calibration does not qualify a batch.
related.difference: 從成品、加工餘量與飛邊建立毛坯體積帳，並分清材料利用率和鍛造品質。
related.differenceEn: Build a billet-volume ledger from finished shape, allowance and flash, separating material utilization from forging quality.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: Lfinal=Lcad(1−s)，因此 Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s)。；教學目標 Ltarget=40.00 mm，線性收縮率 s=0.005。；Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm。
近似不可壓縮塑性變形使金屬體積守恆；質量效率=有用成品體積/投入體積，氧化損失另列。 教學投入體積 120 cm³，成品 90 cm³，加工餘量 10 cm³，飛邊 20 cm³，密度視為一致。 90+10+20=120 cm³；成品利用率 90/120=75%。飛邊不是額外憑空增加的體積。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Lfinal=Lcad(1−s), hence Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s).; Teaching target Ltarget=40.00 mm and linear shrinkage s=0.005.; Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm.

Approximately incompressible plastic flow conserves metal volume; utilization=useful finished volume/input volume, with oxidation loss separate. Teaching input 120 cm³, finished part 90 cm³, machining allowance 10 cm³ and flash 20 cm³ at common density. 90+10+20=120 cm³; finished utilization=90/120=75%. Flash must come from the same input volume.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

courses.overview: 比較相鄰案例與另一組案例的模型、可量測結果及可轉移的驗證方法。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighboring and cross-group cases by model, measurable outcome, and transferable verification method.
